tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises diagnostics on an edited json_editable_document where a viewed value was subsequently erased, triggering the not-found path in diagnostics() with edited=true.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises diagnostics on a non-edited json_document where an erased or detached view is queried for diagnostics, triggering the not-found path with edited=false.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises diagnostics on a nested removed element within an edited document, testing the not-found return path for diagnostics with nested values.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises diagnostics on an array element view after the array itself has been modified or cleared in an editable document, hitting value_path with edited=true returning false.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises diagnostics on a view of an object member that was overwritten with a scalar, verifying that looking up diagnostics on the old view hits the not-found path.
